title: Correct Partition Function
description: Essential Criteria: The partition function Z must be correctly derived and presented.

title: Average Open Links
description: Essential Criteria: The average number of open links must be accurately calculated and expressed.

title: Limit Condition Application
description: Important Criteria: The limit condition of beta epsilon >> 1 must be correctly applied in the calculation.

title: Mathematical Derivation
description: Important Criteria: Key steps in the derivation of the partition function and average number of open links must be shown.

title: Neglecting Terms
description: Optional Criteria: The reasoning for neglecting certain terms in the limit should be clearly stated.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Common sign mistakes in the expressions for Z or average number of open links must be avoided.

title: Units Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: Ensure that all terms are dimensionally consistent throughout the calculations.
